invariants: Only M01-validated real rights-cleared G1/G2 fixture classes can enter a Golden candidate corpus.
Fixture manifest SHA, mixture SHA and G1 reference-stem SHA identities are bound into the corpus lock.
Duplicate mixture audio cannot be counted as independent coverage when duplicate rejection is enabled.
Declared sample rate, channels and duration must agree with the actual WAV mixture; G1 references must align with the mixture.
G1 and G2 class/group roles cannot be swapped by the corpus index.
Corpus coverage is checked across genre, duration, production bucket, requested role sets and hard-case diversity.
The intake report contains hashes/coverage metadata only and omits media paths, titles and raw rights-record IDs.
READY_FOR_HQ_GOLDEN_GATE is intake readiness only and never a PARITY claim.

broad_fault_suite.note: Executed against the final A19 module with an M01-compatible evaluation_core seam; all fixtures are synthetic fault/schema test material and are not Golden evidence.

current_m01_interface_audit.note: Current branch evaluation_core source was inspected and the imported interfaces/semantics used by A19 are present.

external_gaps: No rights-cleared real G1/G2 corpus has been supplied, so no production Golden corpus lock exists.
A19 cannot infer legal rights or prove real/non-synthetic provenance from waveform content alone; verified rights records/attestations remain authoritative inputs.
HQ must approve the final corpus coverage policy values before an actual Golden corpus is accepted.
Live separator, current-iPhone Moises differential, blind review and real-device evidence remain separate gates.
